answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and reported only in the primary region during peak settlement writes. Circuit breaking would shed customer writes (contra the objective; b4 was a partner fail-fast, not our write path). Read-replica routing addresses reporting load (b5), not writes. A release 2h ago is a plausible cause and rollback was clean in b1, but b6 describes canary cohorts rather than a confirmed regional stage, so a global/percent canary would not by itself explain primary-only symptoms. That regional signature matches b2 more closely. Shifting the write primary during settlement still risks write durability/consistency, so treat root cause as unproven, flag downstream write risk, and intend a guarded failover rather than a full cutover. Verify b2 for whether prior failover preserved in-flight writes under load.
